//: Autopilot plugin settings — copy relevant sections to your Claude Code settings.json

autopilot.//costTracker: Set to false to disable token cost tracking (privacy opt-out)
autopilot.//protectedBranches: Regex alternation of branch names to protect (anchored with ^...$)

//opt-in-hooks: Copy individual hook entries below into your settings.json hooks section to enable them

SessionStart.//: version-drift-check: in dev mode, warns if your autopilot clone is behind its git upstream (no network — uses last fetch). Silent for release/marketplace users.

PreToolUse.//: branch-protection: hard-blocks direct commits / force-push on protected branches (autopilot.protectedBranches, default main|master)
commit-secret-scan: hard-blocks git commit when staged changes contain secrets
large-file-warner: warns at 500KB, hard-blocks Read at 2MB (bypass with offset/limit)
config-protection: blocks edits to linter/formatter config files
mcp-health (pre): exponential backoff for unhealthy MCP servers

PostToolUse.//: accumulator: collects edited JS/TS paths for batch-format
test-runner: auto-runs sibling tests on edit (requires vitest or jest)
design-quality: warns on generic template UI patterns

PostToolUseFailure.//: mcp-health (failure): marks MCP server unhealthy on infra errors

Stop.//: cost-tracker: sums per-turn token usage from the transcript → ~/.claude/metrics/costs.jsonl (cache-aware cost). Opt-out: AUTOPILOT_COST_TRACKER=false / autopilot.costTracker=false
session-summary: appends cwd / git status / recent commits to ~/.claude/sessions/{date}-{sid}.md at session end
check-console: warns about console.log in modified files
batch-format: runs Prettier + tsc on all edited JS/TS files (requires accumulator)

SessionEnd.//: session-handoff (writer): on /clear (or logout) auto-decides if meaningful work happened (dirty tree / commits since session start / active project touched / substantive transcript) and, if so, writes a machine handoff snapshot to ~/.autopilot/handoff/<repo-hash>.md (NOT into your repo — docs/HANDOFF.md is never touched). Does nothing otherwise. Fail-open. To ALSO auto-inject that snapshot into the next session, enable the reader gate (default OFF): env AUTOPILOT_HANDOFF_INJECT=1 OR ~/.autopilot/config.json {"handoff_inject":true} — the existing session-start hook then injects it once (consume-once) on a clear/startup. Thresholds: AUTOPILOT_HANDOFF_MIN_USER_TURNS (3) / AUTOPILOT_HANDOFF_MIN_TOOL_CALLS (12)
